{{Short description|German politician (born 1968)}}
'''Antje Töpfer''' (born 22 May 1968 in [[Ludwigsfelde]], [[East Germany]]) is a German politician from [[Alliance 90/The Greens]]. From December 2022 to September 2024 she was State Secretary in the Ministry of Social Affairs, Health, Integration and Consumer Protection of the State of [[Brandenburg]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-03-03 |title=Töpfer und Raschke bilden Spitzenduo der Grünen im Landtagswahlkampf |url=https://www.rbb24.de/politik/beitrag/2024/03/toepfer-raschke-pitzenkandidaur-gruene-brandenburg-landtagswahl.html |access-date=2024-08-16 |website=www.rbb24.de |language=de}}</ref>

== Career ==
Töpfer [[Abitur|graduated from high school]] in 1986. From 1986 to 1990 she studied to become a qualified teacher of [[chemistry]] and [[biology]] at the ''{{Ill|Pädagogischen Hochschule Potsdam|lt=|de|Pädagogischen Hochschule Potsdam}}''.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Göldner |first=Igor |date=2023-10-13 |title=Grüne Antje Töpfer will in Brandenburg Spitzenkandidatin zur Landtagswahl werden |url=https://www.maz-online.de/brandenburg/gruene-antje-toepfer-will-in-brandenburg-spitzenkandidatin-zur-landtagswahl-werden-RD5YCPFLUFHIZDEVFVDNZN4JEM.html |access-date=2024-08-16 |website=www.maz-online.de |language=de}}</ref> From 1990 to 1994 she studied food chemistry at [[Technische Universität Berlin]]. She completed her studies with part A of the state examination. From 1994 to 1995 she completed scientific internships at the Institute of Food Chemistry at the TU Berlin. From 1996 to 1998 she completed a postgraduate course in food chemistry at the TU Berlin. She graduated with a diploma . From 1995 to 1999 she worked as a research assistant at the Institute of Food Chemistry at the TU Berlin. She received her doctorate there in 1999. From 1998 to 2001 and in 2009 she worked as a freelance research assistant at ''Dorel Verlags GmbH & CoKG''. From 2001 to 2006 she worked as a research assistant at the Federal Institute for Materials Research and Testing. From 2006 to 2007 she worked at the [[Deutsches Institut für Normung|German Institute for Standardization]]. From 2010 to 2015 she worked as a research assistant in the office of the Senate of the Federal Research Institutes in the business area of the [[Federal Ministry of Food and Agriculture (Germany)|Federal Ministry of Food and Agriculture]]. From 2015 until her appointment as State Secretary in 2022 she was a consultant in the Federal Ministry of Food and Agriculture.

On 5 December 2022, Töpfer was appointed State Secretary in the Ministry of Social Affairs, Health, Integration and Consumer Protection of the State of Brandenburg, succeeding {{Ill|Anna Heyer-Stuffer|lt=|de|}}.

Töpfer is a member of the [[Havelland (district)|Havelland district]] council and chairwoman of the local Green Party group.

In the [[2024 Brandenburg state election]], Töpfer was the Green Party's top candidate together with [[Benjamin Raschke]].<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2024-03-12 |date=2024-03-11 |title=Spitzenduo der Grünen für die Landtagswahl in Brandburg gewählt |url=https://www.politik-kommunikation.de/personalwechsel/spitzenduo-der-gruenen-fuer-die-landtagswahl-in-brandburg-gewaehlt/ |website=politik-kommunikation.de}}<!-- auto-translated from German by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> They led the party to defeat, suffering an [[electoral wipeout]], [[Unseating|losing]] all their seats.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-09-23 |title=Grüne, Linke und Freie Wähler fliegen aus dem Landtag - keine Direktmandate erreicht |url=https://www.rbb24.de/politik/wahl/Landtagswahl/2024/brandenburg-linke-bvb-freie-wahler-gruene-direktmandat-landtagswahl.html |access-date=2024-09-23 |website=www.rbb24.de |language=de}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
She lives in a [[civil partnership]] and has two children.
